Discovery & Analysis: Conduct stakeholder interviews to document the questions and feedback on current RFP process, identifying gaps, pain points, and critical risk areas. Benchmarking: Leverage market intelligence and industry best practices to benchmark and identify opportunities for improving Zebra's tier 1 RFP process and quoting template. Process Design & Optimization: Design and propose an optimized, end-to-end process flow, incorporating feedback from cross-functional stakeholders to gain final approval. Documentation & Governance: Create detailed process maps and an enhanced quoting template with detailed working instructions. Communication & Reporting: Establish a regular communication cadence with management, providing clear and concise readouts on project milestones, progress, and dependencies. Current enrollment in a MBA with an anticipated graduation date by May 2027 Must be authorized to work in the Canada without requiring sponsorship now or in the future A proactive and intellectually curious learner with a passion for personal growth. Strong business acumen with the ability to transform data into insights and strategic solutions. Proven leadership and a history of excellence in professional, academic, or other settings. Highly collaborative with demonstrated success working within a team environment. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and modern AI productivity tools.

Develops, designs, evaluates, and/or modifies systems consistent with customer and regulatory requirements. Develops system architecture, and ensures the integrity of the architecture/design. Performs system feasibility studies and evaluates alternative technology applications. Collaborates with Product Management and Customers to decompose customer use cases into correct features for new product development. Defines the solutions and system requirements for highly complex system design projects. Represents systems engineering as technical contact on assigned projects. Successfully collaborates and communicates with software and hardware sub-system development teams. Integrates new technologies and solutions based on emerging market/industry technologies. Assimilates technology roadmaps in critical product areas. Lead product feature trade-offs for performance, cost and schedule, while meeting the customer expectations Utilizes, develops, and applies advanced tools, including AI-powered solutions, for requirements analysis, system design optimization, automated validation, and the resolution of complex problems. Evaluates competitor products through data driven competitive benchmarking. Manages and coordinates the activities of other engineering personnel and often performs technical project leadership. Mentors more junior level personnel. Work in the agile development process to release products in a timely fashion Exercises independent judgment in methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Networks with key contacts outside their own area of expertise. Interacts with Product Management to provide technical responses to RFPs and RFIs which lead to successful future engagement with key customers. Will be responsible for supporting lighthouse customer opportunities and accounts via the customer engagement methodology. Bachelor's degree in engineering with 5 + years of experience or Masters degree and 4+ year experience Proven System Engineering experience ideally in the Mobile computing space Able to clearly communicate complex concepts to broadly diverse audiences and guide both local and remote teams in achieving their goals. Experienced in defining system requirements from complex customer use cases. Demonstrated proficiency in dealing with ambiguity and ability to stay focused and to clear barriers. Strong ability to present detailed information at the appropriate level. Experience working on Handheld devices on Android platform. Successfully held a recent role as a System Engineering role working on a product development effort that ultimately led to a successful Market launch/customer delivery. Recent hands-on experience in the full lifecycle (cradle to grave) development of Enterprise class productivity devices and/or the associated application ecosystem is highly desirable. Working knowledge of the Agile development process. Experience in hardware design and implementation. Experience in solutions for Payment/POS applications is a plus. Experience in Android HAL, Framework, Security, and Applications. Recent working knowledge of latest wireless technologies spanning: (i.e.) 4G/LTE/5G NR, GNSS/UWB, Wi-Fi/802.11(x), NFC, HF/UHF-RFID, Bluetooth/BLE.

Performs the physical and/or administrative tasks involved in the shipping, receiving, storing, distributing and order fulfillment of merchandise, products, materials, parts, supplies and equipment. Performs quality checks on outbound and inbound shipments. Performs outbound staging and packing in accordance with site policies. Executes ERP system transactions on outbound and inbound shipments. Updates FMS for parcel and freight shipments. Learns to use handheld RF scanners and Warehouse Management System to fulfill orders. Maintains inventory accuracy. Handles and controls hazardous material on both inbound and outbound. Complies with 5S safety, housekeeping practices, and regulations. Completes all required safety training and follows protocol in all risk situations. Uses Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) appropriate to tasks at hand. Lifts up to 75 pounds unassisted. Certification on powered industrial trucks including work assist vehicle (WAV), off the ground order picker (up to 35' off the ground), reach truck, dock stocker and powered pallet jacks. Creates repair RMA's, manages receiving and shipment issues within repair systems. Develops familiarity with a subset of products, processes, operational metrics and software tools; learns and follows basic work instructions for functional assignments according to productivity and quality standards Provides input geared towards continuous improvement, work instruction documentation, and standardization of processes. Resolves a variety of basic problems of limited complexity under direct supervision and performs rudimentary analysis involving a limited number of factors. Creates expense orders for internal repair consumption. Full knowledge of ISO requirements and demonstrated ability to ensure compliance with external auditors. Previous Standup forklift operation. Process Improvement Mindset: A strong, inherent desire to find better ways of doing things and a proactive approach to identifying inefficiencies is a must-have for this role. Interest in AI and Automation: A demonstrated interest and foundational skills in AI and automation technologies, with a curiosity for how they can be applied to improve business processes and services. Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field is preferred. Analytical Mindset: A natural curiosity and good analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail. Willingness to Learn: Eagerness to learn about the ITIL framework, process improvement methodologies, and new technologies. Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present information clearly. Collaboration: A proactive, collaborative attitude and the ability to work effectively within a team environment. Tool Proficiency: Strong skills in the Microsoft Suite and scripting for data automation and analysis.
